sentences.text: No, a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges on an existing floating rate term loan sanctioned before December 31, 2025 to an individual for a purpose other than business.

The same result applies to this case because the borrower is an individual, the facility is a term loan, the rate is floating, the purpose is non-business, and the sanction date is before December 31, 2025.
The earlier 2014 floating-rate foreclosure-charge circular is no longer in force, and the current UCB directions control instead.
